mapper.select: SELECT id, slot_no, state, first_account_id, second_account_id, first_name, second_name, started_at, opened_at, expires_at, closed_at, close_reason, last_reading, streak, present_uids, removed_uids, ignored_uids, suppressed, dual_alarm FROM cabinet_session WHERE slot_no = #{slot} AND state IN ('waiting', 'open') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cabinet_session ( slot_no, state, first_account_id, second_account_id, first_name, second_name, started_at, opened_at, expires_at, closed_at, close_reason, last_reading, streak, present_uids, removed_uids, ignored_uids, suppressed, dual_alarm ) VALUES ( #{slotNo}, #{state}, #{firstAccountId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{secondAccountId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{firstName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{secondName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{openedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{closedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{closeReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lastReading,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{streak}, #{presentUids}, #{removedUids}, #{ignoredUids}, #{suppressed}, #{dualAlarm} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cabinet_session SET state = #{state}, second_account_id = #{secondAccountId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, second_name = #{secondName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, opened_at = #{openedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, expires_at = #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, closed_at = #{closedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, close_reason = #{closeReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, last_reading = #{lastReading,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, streak = #{streak}, present_uids = #{presentUids}, removed_uids = #{removedUids}, ignored_uids = #{ignoredUids}, suppressed = #{suppressed}, dual_alarm = #{dualAlarm} WHERE id = #{id}
